top_signals.title: Aliko Dangote, Investment Banks Sign Africa’s Biggest IPO Deal
top_signals.summary: Aliko Dangote and his financial advisers signed registration documents for the initial public offering of his refinery business as Africa’s richest man takes a key step toward launching the continent’s biggest share sale to date.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Berlin investigates new data leak after hackers publish stolen login credentials
top_signals.summary: Another trove of data from Berlin's government has appeared online, authorities said. Germany's information security agency separately warned about the Rhysida cybercrime group.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
